item.description:
Obtain Entra tokens for an **already registered** user.

Redirect URI: SPA auth callback from **FGS Globals** `redirectUri` (must match `Application:UiAuthCallbackUrl`, e.g. `https://developer.fsm.com/auth/callback`).

## Recommended â€” Manual browser flow
1. Select **FGS Globals (Local)** environment.
2. Set `entraUserEmail`, `entraClientSecret`.
3. Ensure gateway is running on `https://developer.fsm.com`.
4. Run **Manual browser flow â†’ 1. Copy sign-in URL to console** â†’ **Send**.
5. Open **View â†’ Show Postman Console**, copy URL into Chrome/Edge, sign in.
6. Browser redirects to the SPA callback. **Copy `code=` from the address bar**.
7. Paste into environment variable `authCode`.
8. Run **2. Exchange Authorization Code** â†’ `accessToken` is set automatically.
9. Use other FGS collections (FileService, SetupService, etc.).

## Token lifetime
Access tokens ~60 min. `offline_access` returns a **refresh token** â€” run **3. Refresh Access Token** to renew.

request.description:

The FGS redirect URI is `https://developer.fsm.com/auth/callback`. After Entra login the browser lands on that URL with `?code=...` in the address bar.

the SPA callback page may show an error JSON (it expects an invitation `state` for onboarding). That is OK â€” **copy the `code` from the URL** before the page loads or from the address bar, set `authCode`, then run **2. Exchange Authorization Code**.

Postman **Get New Access Token** (collection Authorization tab) does **not** auto-return when using the SPA callback URL â€” use the manual flow instead.
